[EarthEcho Water-Quality Analysis Dictionary — PosAIdon Knowledge Reference › Sheet 3 — Individual parameter raw-value reference bands › pH — Too low (acidic)]
### pH — Too low (acidic)

**Range:** <6.5

**Meaning/Potential Cause:** Acid rain, mining pollution, decomposition, changes in watershed chemistry, coal storage, landfills (under certain conditions), and some fertilizers
